payload.purpose_context: PR #133 introduced a shared rule that maps a docs file to its route, but several surfaces still build addresses their own way, index names are configured in three places, and some index-file collisions go unreported. This mission closes those follow-ups (#134-#139) before 0.3.0 ships, so adopters migrate once.
payload.purpose_tldr: Give DocKitty one source of truth for page routes and index names, so links, feeds, the sidebar and collision checks agree.

payload.question: The sidebar's own docs walk skips a _meta/ folder; the shared walk (loader, route table, link check) does not. When the sidebar moves onto the shared walk, should _meta/ be excluded everywhere or nowhere?
Should --index-basename index,README count as matching a configured README,index (same names, different order)?
Should two ordinary pages whose routes differ only by letter case (Guide.md and guide.md) be a failing route collision?

payload.final_answer: Yes: same set is enough (order-insensitive comparison)

payload.wp_title: Sidebar on the shared walk and route rule, _meta excluded
Route-keyed collisions stop the build and the strict check
Glossary autolinker skips reference-style link text
Address builders onto the shared route rule, with a guard
